fusions.name: Heartwood Split
fusions.desc: A falling chop at an enemy at or below 30% health that deals 18 damage, leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds and sets it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Windmill Cut
fusions.desc: Swings a burning axe head in a full circle, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Honed Edge
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit damage by 35% for 12 seconds. For the first 8 seconds, sparks off the blade strike your enemies for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Flying Splinters
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, a burning splinter flies to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles, deals 6 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
